claims: Parades and festivals for the 2026 St. Patrick's Day season in the Washington D.C., Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) area primarily occur on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
Most regional parades take place on the Saturday prior to St. Patrick's Day (March 17).
Gaithersburg St. Patrick's Day Parade is on Saturday, March 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM at Rio Gaithersburg.
Gaithersburg St. Patrick's Day Parade is the 24th annual parade.
Gaithersburg St. Patrick's Day Parade begins at 10:00 AM on March 14, 2026.
Gaithersburg St. Patrick's Day Parade features Celtic dancers, bagpipe bands, school groups, and fire trucks.
Fire trucks travel through the shopping center in Gaithersburg St. Patrick's Day Parade.
Ireland at The Wharf is a free waterfront festival from 1:00 PM to 7:00 PM on March 14, 2026.
A pipe band marches from Kirwan's on the Wharf to the District Pier stage at 12:45 PM on March 14, 2026.
Ireland at The Wharf includes live music, dancing, and Six Nations Rugby viewing.
Ocean City St. Patrick's Day Parade kicks off at 12:00 PM on March 14, 2026.
Ocean City St. Patrick's Day Parade travels south along Coastal Highway from 60th Street to 44th Street.
An accompanying Irish Festival at 45th Street for Ocean City St. Patrick's Day Parade begins at 11:00 AM on March 14, 2026.
City of Hagerstown St. Patrick's Day Street Festival is on Saturday, March 14, 2026 at 11:00 AM at Hub City Brewery.
City of Hagerstown St. Patrick's Day Street Festival follows the Saint Patrick's Day Run Fest.
City of Hagerstown St. Patrick's Day Street Festival includes live entertainment.
City of Hagerstown St. Patrick's Day Street Festival supports the Washington County Community Free Clinic.
The main St. Patrick's Day Parade in the Inner Harbor in Baltimore is scheduled for Sunday, March 15, 2026 starting at 2:00 PM near the Washington Monument.
The 43rd Alexandria St. Patrick's Day Parade occurred on Saturday, March 7, 2026.
The 59th Annual Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade is on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
Street closures for the Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade begin at 7:30 AM on March 14, 2026.
The Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade starts later that morning on March 14, 2026.
